name: unit_toe
title: Unit TO&E assignments (data/unit_toe.csv)
description: Hand-maintained. One sourced assignment of one unit to one TO&E template for one interval. Modelled on unit_commanders.csv, but simpler: no claims-join table and no conflict groups in v1. Assignment ids UT0001 onward are never reused or renumbered. A unit with no row has no authorized table recorded.

fields.name: assignment_id
fields.description: Stable id, UT0001 onward. Never reused or renumbered.

fields.name: valid_from
fields.description: First day the unit is on this table, YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: valid_to
fields.description: Last day, inclusive. Blank if still on the table at the end of recorded life.

fields.name: valid_to_basis
fields.description: Where valid_to comes from (vocabulary relation_end_basis). Prefer open when valid_to is blank; do not use open_at_last_claim.

fields.name: conformance
fields.description: How closely the unit matched the table (vocabulary toe_conformance).

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: Usual tiers (vocabulary confidence): 0.3 a single source that this unit used this table; 0.5 a day-level conversion or edition date; 0.7 a second source family agrees.

fields.name: reference_ids
fields.description: Sources that this unit was on this table in this interval. A template citation alone is not enough if the unit's edition is in doubt.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Conversion remarks, not-yet-reorganized, or why conformance is modified.
